context.brief: untracked/T387-capture-budget-termination.md (kanban set=M; landmark L2 (proven 4x4 values)). The operator's idea: bound total captures over a game by B; then after B captures no capture is legal, stones only add, the game must terminate. Investigate: (1) the termination argument, (2) the state-space cost (exact multiplier at 3x3/4x3/4x4, bytes), (3) the hypothesis that the budget resolves exactly the bracketed region and leaves the determined region unchanged (test at 3x3, sweep B), (4) capture counts along optimal lines at 3x3/4x3, (5) the longest games in the bracketed region with boards, (6) the area-vs-territory scoring asymmetry.
